scene: A sunny island shore with a palm tree and wooden dock: a white puppy settler plants a little flag and digs with a spade, a stocky gray hippo miner carries a shovel, a small chibi lion cub with NO mane and green neckerchief watches the blue sea, hopeful morning.

A golden desert with railroad tracks and oil derricks: a camel oil baron with a flat cap stands proudly on a stage holding a big coin, below a white duck sailor and a small fluffy brown puppy with cream muzzle look lost and hungry in the heat.

A small school with red roof on an island by a dock: young monkey students with satchels wave goodbye to their island, one holds a notebook, a plump elderly brown owl with spectacles and red scarf teaches at the door, boats waiting.

A warm lit print-shop window at night in a dark street: a raccoon printer apprentice with ink-stained paws holds a quill surprised by what he printed, a stocky gray hippo miner leans in, a cream rabbit girl with a red bow gasps at the glowing pages.

A wooden notice board in a village square: a big water buffalo chairman with a necktie reads bad news looking worried, a cheerful raccoon printer apprentice explains, a stocky gray hippo miner nods, villagers gathering.

A village festival with a red banner and bunting: a raccoon printer apprentice holds up a new declaration scroll proudly, a big water buffalo chairman with a necktie smiles beside him, a small chibi lion cub with NO mane and green neckerchief claps happily, confetti.

A town of grey stone houses in a mountain valley: a young monkey with a red bowtie walks determinedly, a striped orange tiger emperor watches from a balcony, a tiny human boy age 5 with dark bowl-cut hair and mint-green shirt looks up at the biggest hall.

Inside a great hall stands an enormous golden throne too big for anyone: a striped orange tiger emperor sits on it proudly, a young monkey with a red bowtie gasps below, a small fluffy brown puppy with cream muzzle hides behind a pillar.

The golden throne under moonlight: a young monkey with a red bowtie and a small beret sits on it looking small and sad, a plump elderly brown owl with spectacles and red scarf watches wisely, a tiny human boy age 5 with dark bowl-cut hair yawns by a column.

A very long queue of tired chibi animals outside a small bakery with a bread sign: a small gray mouse girl, a wise old turtle grandma with round glasses, and an old goat in a cap wait in line, grey morning light.

A giant messy pile of colorful banknotes and a huge coin: a stocky gray hippo miner looks sad holding one tiny coin, a wise old turtle grandma with round glasses inspects a banknote, a small chibi lion cub with NO mane and green neckerchief examines it with his magnifying glass.

A row of once-grand little houses in dusty sunset: a wise old turtle grandma with round glasses holds an old photo notebook sadly, a white duck sailor sits drooping, a plump elderly brown owl with spectacles and red scarf comforts them.

A bright new school with red roof in a golden desert: a dignified leopard in glasses stands proudly, a stocky gray hippo miner takes notes, a small chibi lion cub with NO mane and green neckerchief smiles, a small diamond sparkle glints on the ground.

A vintage bus at a stop: a plump brown hen lady sits firmly and refuses to stand, a big water buffalo chairman with a necktie looks away embarrassed, a cream rabbit girl with a red bow watches in awe, warm afternoon light.

A big campfire under a huge tree at night with many little farmers gathered in a circle: two goat farmers in caps speak, a wise old turtle grandma with round glasses smiles warmly, a small fluffy brown puppy with cream muzzle dozes, stars and fireflies.

Night under the huge ancient banyan tree with a glowing paper lantern: a plump elderly brown owl with spectacles and red scarf and a gentle old gray-blue elephant with a blue cap sit like grandparents telling a story, a small chibi lion cub with NO mane and green neckerchief, a tiny human boy age 5 with dark bowl-cut hair, and a small fluffy brown puppy listen, fireflies.

Close warm scene under the lantern: a small chibi lion cub with NO mane and green neckerchief opens his notebook in wonder, a plump elderly brown owl with spectacles and red scarf smiles, a tiny human boy age 5 with dark bowl-cut hair rests his chin on his hands listening, golden glow, stars.

Under the banyan at night the friends plant a small green sapling: a small chibi lion cub with NO mane and green neckerchief holds a little flowerpot, a tiny human boy age 5 with dark bowl-cut hair fills soil with both hands, a plump elderly brown owl with spectacles and red scarf and a gentle old gray-blue elephant with a blue cap smile, a small fluffy brown puppy pours water from a tiny can, fireflies and stars.
